alt: Two illustrative photon-flux timelines: constant PPFD and variable PPFD; the shaded area under each curve represents daily light integral. Formula uses micromoles per square metre per second and seconds to obtain moles per square metre per day.
caption: DLI is the area under the PPFD-versus-time curve. The constant-light arithmetic example is illustrative; the variable-light profile is schematic, not experimental data.

source.title: Cannabis Yield, Potency, and Leaf Photosynthesis Respond Differently to Increasing Light Levels in an Indoor Environment
source.authors: Rodriguez-Morrison V, Llewellyn D, Zheng Y
